stories.description: Astronomers using JWST have discovered that massive early galaxies contain far more small, faint stars than expected. The finding makes it even harder to explain how enormous, mature galaxies formed so soon after the Big Bang. It could also suggest that planets around low-mass stars were more common in the early universe than scientists realized.
